decisions.reason: As a low-risk but system-consistent care add-on that extends the firm's full flooring offer, the cleaning soap benefits from continued commitment and is likely to be retained unless demand clearly weakens.

The maintenance oil line is closely tied to the installed base of wooden floors and, after another year on the market, the firm's investment and visible commitment make withdrawal relatively unlikely.

Although the underlay foam is a more substitutable accessory than core flooring products, its survival after the 2024 range pruning suggests management now sees it as the preferred complementary underlay and will tend to continue with it.
